Philip James Bailey, Festus
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/philip-james-bailey/festus

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Philip James Bailey, the author, died 1902.

First publication of the text used: 1839 (SE colophon: 'Festus was published in 1839 by Philip James Bailey.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1839, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1934.
- Country of origin: every person named above died in 1925 or earlier, so this text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last to die did so in 1902.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
